set.body: Forward-review P0. embed-core/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/embed/privacy.scala:45-51 exposes a public case-class constructor/copy for PseudonymizedText; contract.scala:176-192 trusts every Sanitized value; privacy.scala:103-132 then authorizes it. Executable repro: PseudonymizedText(policy,key,"Jane Smith had cancer",Vector.empty) passes Embedder.preflight for a Remote/PublicOnly provider and RemotePolicy.evaluate returns Right. The type therefore does not prove pseudonymization, and offset pairs are unvalidated. Proposed scope: embed-core privacy/contract + tests, coordinated with W3 bd-01M14XGRY0TBVBAQ7P9NRVEV66. Acceptance: external callers cannot construct/copy the value; only a validated pseudonymizer or checked factory can; source/destination spans are ordered, in bounds, nonoverlapping, and code-point-safe; authorization binds the same sanitized request value; negative construction law plus laundering regression on JVM/JS/Native.
set.title: P0 embed privacy: make PseudonymizedText an unforgeable validated remote-safe value
